data.document_title: Amended and Restated Joint Venture Contract of BHR Partners (Shanghai) Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd.

summary: Publicly surfaced copy of a 2023 amended and restated joint-venture contract for BHR Partners (Shanghai) Equity Investment Fund Management Co., Ltd. The copy identifies parties, subscribed registered capital, representatives, and governance rights, but the surfaced version contains a blank signature date and blank signature fields; execution and chain of custody are not independently verified.
title: 2023 BHR amended joint-venture contract copy
